nodes.summary: Let $H$ be an inner product space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $(v_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be an orthonormal sequence in $H$. Then $v_n$ does not tend to $0$ in norm as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: An orthonormal sequence does not converge strongly to `0`

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a Hilbert space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $(v_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be an orthonormal sequence in $H$. Then for every continuous linear functional $f : H \to \mathbb{K}$, we have $f(v_n) \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: An orthonormal sequence tends weakly to `0`

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a Hilbert space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(v_i)_{i \in \iota}$ be an orthonormal family in $H$ and let $f : H \to \mathbb{K}$ be a continuous linear functional. Then $f(v_i)$ tends to $0$ along the cofinite filter on $\iota$: for every $\varepsilon > 0$, $|f(v_i)| < \varepsilon$ for all but finitely many $i$.
nodes.title: An orthonormal family tends weakly to `0`

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be an inner product space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(v_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be an orthonormal sequence in $H$ and let $x \in H$. Then $\langle v_n, x \rangle \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Fourier coefficients along an orthonormal sequence tend to `0`

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be an inner product space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(v_i)_{i \in \iota}$ be an orthonormal family in $H$ and let $x \in H$. Then the inner products $\langle v_i, x \rangle$ tend to $0$ along the cofinite filter on $\iota$: for every $\varepsilon > 0$, $|\langle v_i, x \rangle| < \varepsilon$ for all but finitely many $i$.
nodes.title: Fourier coefficients along an orthonormal family tend to `0`

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
